trigger: colab/impute_reg_sign.py found |SMD| 0.25 in its decile-matched swapped source and the tightening moved its increment by more than the effect was worth

power_weighted.label: POWER-WEIGHTED z (admitted today on the decile control)

limits: this audits the SOURCE side of the swap only. The target gene is held fixed by construction in this control and is not at issue
the nearest-in-strength arm uses a fixed neighbourhood of 25 ranks. A tighter neighbourhood balances better and shrinks the pool, and no attempt was made to tune that trade-off

the joint arm matches RPE1 cell count among the nearest-in-strength candidates rather than jointly optimising both, so its balance on cell count is better than the nearest arm's but is not guaranteed to be under the bar
it does not re-audit the decile-matched MAGNITUDE control used by the project's fast test, which is a different comparison with a different matching and needs its own pass
5 seeds per construction. The seed spread is reported and the increments here are large relative to it, but 5 is few for a spread estimate
verdict: BOTH HEADLINES SURVIVE THE TIGHTER CONTROL. The decile-matched swapped source leaves |SMD| 0.020 on RPE1 perturbation strength for the incumbent |z| >= 5 edge set, inside the 0.10 balance bar, so the defect impute_reg_sign found on curated TF sources does NOT reproduce on this edge set -- the two differ because curated sources are all TFs and sit at the top of their decile, while a |z| >= 5 edge set spans the whole strength range. Recomputed under three constructions of the control, the incumbent increment reads +0.1520 (decile), +0.1528 (nearest in strength), +0.1494 (nearest + cell-count matched) -- a span of 0.0035, or 2% of the decile value. The power-weighted rule reads +0.1805 / +0.1823 / +0.1784, a span of 0.0039. The ordering between the two rules is preserved under every construction, so today's admission of the power-weighted rule does not depend on which control was used.
